# n8n_tags (Data Source)

Lists all n8n global tags via `GET /api/v1/tags` with cursor pagination.

The nested `tags` list is sorted by id. There is no name filter on the Public API list endpoint in v1.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "n8n_tags" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Data source identifier. Always `tags`.
- `tags` (Attributes List) Tags returned by GET /tags after following pagination. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp from n8n.
- `id` (String) Tag ID.
- `name` (String) Tag name.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp from n8n.
